covpp.sequence.connect_paths module

Path connection module.

class ConnectPaths(map_ws: ndarray, g_xy: tuple[int, int], ns: str = '')

Bases: object

Generate transition paths between consecutive coverage cells.

Uses A* pathfinding algorithm to find collision-free paths connecting the end point of one cell's coverage path to the start point of the next cell in the sequence.

covpp.sequence.sequence_handler module

Sequence optimization module for cell ordering and path connection.

This module handles the sequencing of coverage cells, connection of individual cell paths, and generation of the complete zone coverage path.

class SequenceHandler(zmd: ZoneMapData)

Bases: object

Optimize cell visit order and create complete connected coverage path.

This class handles the sequencing problem (determining optimal cell visit order) and path connection (creating transitions between cells) to generate a complete coverage path for the zone.

paths (SequencePaths)

Pipeline Steps:

  1. Optimize cell visit sequence

  2. Connect paths between consecutive cells

  3. Apply distance filtering and smoothing

  4. Generate complete path

  5. Update visualization maps

covpp.sequence.sequence_optimizer_base module

Cell sequencing optimization base class.

class SeqOptimizerBase

Bases: object

Reusable scaffolding for sequencing plug-ins.

Process:

  1. run stores the planning cells plus any optional distance matrix.

  2. create_tour (implemented by subclasses) computes the visiting order.

  3. set_cells_optim_ind writes the sequence metadata back into each cell.

Result:

Subclasses must populate tour_idxs and tour_ids to describe the visit order. success indicates whether the optimizer produced a feasible tour.

run(cells: list[PCell], start_idx: int = 0, distances: ndarray = None)

Bootstrap optimizer state and delegate to create_tour.

Parameters:

  • cells -- Planning cells that contain adjacency, paths, and metadata.

  • start_idx -- Index of the seed cell in cells.

  • distances -- Optional matrix of pairwise costs (meters or pixels).

Result:

Sets tour_idxs/tour_ids and annotates every cell with opt_id/next_cell_id so downstream handlers can connect paths.

create_tour()

Create tour_idxs and tour_ids for the sequencing strategy.

set_cells_optim_ind()

Assign optimized sequence indices and next cell references to cells.

plot()

Plot the optimized cell sequence.
